candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: safely administer medications; monitor adverse effects; evaluate response; apply medication-specific precautions.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — esketamine REMS administration/monitoring
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize SPRAVATO REMS requirements for directly observed administration in a certified setting and at least 2 hours of post-dose monitoring, including respiratory assessment.

options.A: Dispense the dose for unsupervised home administration after prior tolerance.
options.B: Administer it in a certified health care setting under direct observation and monitor for at least 2 hours after dosing.
options.C: Discharge immediately if no dissociation occurs during the first 15 minutes.
options.D: Monitor only blood pressure because respiratory monitoring is not required.

candidate.rationale: The March 2026 SPRAVATO label requires administration in a REMS-certified health care setting under direct observation and monitoring for at least 2 hours after each session. Respiratory status must also be monitored for at least 2 hours, including pulse oximetry, with blood-pressure assessment. Thus B is correct; A violates REMS supervision, C shortens required observation, and D omits required respiratory monitoring.
candidate.source_claim_supported: SPRAVATO requires directly observed administration in a REMS-certified health care setting and at least 2 hours of post-dose monitoring, including respiratory-status monitoring.
